decision: The overall score counts up; the rubric carries the detail
why: One number is memorable; the rubric is actionable.
value: Motivation plus a clear next step.

decision: Every rubric line cites the transcript timestamp behind it
why: Feedback people can verify is feedback they act on.

decision: Grading runs asynchronously after the session and streams in
why: Grading a 45-minute transcript takes longer than a page load.
alternative: Block the report until grading finishes.
value: The report opens immediately and fills in.

decision: Rubric scores are stored per line to track progress
why: Improvement shows up in lines, not overall scores.
